whatsNew: Missed-Event Catch-Up: if the screen was off when an event fired, opening the app now surfaces a recovery modal listing every missed event. Run each one in order or skip — modal stays until all are addressed.
notes: Fix: service worker update now unregisters stale SW and clears all caches on version mismatch, then hard-reloads so new index.html is fetched cleanly. Previous versions used reg.update() only which left old SW in control and blocked new version from loading.
